views.name: movie_actor_year
views.body_sql: SELECT Movie.MID AS movie_id, Person.PID AS actor_id, Movie.year AS year, Person.Gender AS actor_gender FROM Movie JOIN M_Cast ON Movie.MID = M_Cast.MID JOIN Person ON M_Cast.PID = Person.PID
views.description: links each movie to its cast members and extracts the release year from the movie record

views.name: year_movie_stats
views.body_sql:
SELECT
    year,
    COUNT(DISTINCT movie_id) AS total_movies,
    CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM movie_actor_year m2
        WHERE m2.movie_id = m1.movie_id AND m2.actor_gender != 'Female'
    ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT movie_id) AS percentage_exclusively_female_actors
FROM movie_actor_year m1
GROUP BY year
views.description: evaluates per movie whether all cast members meet the gender condition, then groups by year to compute total movie count and the percentage of movies satisfying the condition
